events.title: Early fort construction — dating window
events.description: The fort belongs to the early Hadrianic building programme; the source places its construction within a decade of AD 122.

evidence.note: 122–132 is an editorial indexing window for the source’s relative dating, not a measured event duration or an exact foundation year.

events.title: Granary rebuilding — dating window
events.description: English Heritage dates major granary rebuilding to AD 205–208.

evidence.note: This is an archaeological dating window, not evidence of continuous work on every date in the interval. No reconstructed building state is supplied.
